alerts.alert: 5 failed logins for k.doran from 185.220.101.4, followed by a success
alerts.behavior: 5 consecutive authentication failures for k.doran from 185.220.101.4, then a successful login from the same IP — consistent with a guessed or stuffed credential that worked.
alerts.impact: Likely account takeover — treat the account as compromised until verified otherwise.
alerts.recommended_action: Force a password/credential reset, review MFA status, and rate-limit or block the source IP.

alerts.behavior: k.doran moved 950 MB out of customer-storage in a single transfer at 2026-09-17T01:31:47Z — well above the 500 MB baseline for normal activity.
alerts.impact: Large single-transfer volumes from a sensitive store are the single strongest signal of bulk data exfiltration, insider or external.
alerts.recommended_action: Suspend k.doran's active sessions pending review, and confirm the transfer against a known, approved business process.

alerts.alert: k.doran disabled audit logging on log-workspace
alerts.behavior: k.doran disabled logging on log-workspace at 2026-09-17T01:40:02Z.
alerts.impact: Tampering with the audit trail is a near-universal signal of an active, deliberate attack — it removes the evidence needed to investigate everything else.
alerts.recommended_action: Treat as an active incident immediately: re-enable/restore logging, isolate k.doran's credentials, and escalate — do not wait for corroborating alerts.

alerts.alert: After-hours privilege change by k.doran on secrets-manager-role
alerts.behavior: k.doran granted/changed permissions on secrets-manager-role at 2026-09-17T01:22:10Z (outside 06:00-22:00 UTC business hours).
alerts.impact: Off-hours IAM changes to sensitive resources are a common early step in both insider misuse and post-compromise privilege escalation.
